messages.指定两点绘制直线段，Esc 结束: Draw line segments through two points; Esc to finish
messages.三维长方体：指定底面两个角点和高度: 3D box: specify two corners of the base and the height
messages.三维圆柱体：指定底面中心、半径和高度: 3D cylinder: specify the base center, radius and height
messages.三维球体：指定中心和半径: 3D sphere: specify the center and radius
messages.先选择闭合的圆、多段线或矩形，再指定高度，拉伸为三维实体: Select a closed circle, polyline or rectangle, then specify a height to extrude it into a 3D solid
messages.俯视（平面视图）：二维绘图的默认视图；三维视图里按住 Shift 拖动中键环绕: Top (plan view): the default view for 2D drafting; in 3D views, hold Shift and drag the middle button to orbit
messages.西南等轴测：从左前上方看；按住 Shift 拖动中键可继续环绕: SW Isometric: view from the front left above; hold Shift and drag the middle button to keep orbiting
messages.画出三维实体的面，三维视图里被挡住的边不显示: Draw the faces of 3D solids; hidden edges are not shown in 3D views
messages.绘图区左上角的视图方块：点面、棱、角切换视图，拖动环绕: ViewCube at the top left of the drawing area: click a face, edge or corner to change the view, drag to orbit
messages.先选择闭合的圆、多段线或矩形，再指定旋转轴和角度，旋转为三维实体: Select a closed circle, polyline or rectangle, then specify an axis and angle to revolve it into a 3D solid
messages.先选择闭合的圆、多段线或矩形，再选择路径（直线、圆弧、圆、多段线），沿路径扫掠为: Select a closed circle, polyline or rectangle, then a path (line, arc, circle, polyline) to sweep it into a 3D solid
messages.点选三维实体的边倒圆角，键入数值改半径，回车完成（Tab 切换重叠的边）: Click edges of a 3D solid to fillet them; type a value to change the radius, Enter to finish (Tab cycles overlapping edges)
messages.点选三维实体的边倒角，键入数值改距离，回车完成（Tab 切换重叠的边）: Click edges of a 3D solid to chamfer them; type a value to change the distance, Enter to finish (Tab cycles overlapping edges)
messages.节点式参数化建模：把几何运算连成节点图，改参数实时更新，点“烘焙”加入图纸（命令: Node-based parametric modeling: connect geometry operations into a node graph, changes update live, click "Bake" to add the result to the drawing (command NODES)
messages.先选择三维实体：键入高度得到水平截面，或点取两点得到铅垂剖面图: Select 3D solids, then type a height for a horizontal section or pick two points for a vertical section
messages.先选择三维实体，按俯视、前视、右视等方向投影成二维图（含隐藏线）: Select 3D solids and project them into a 2D drawing from the top, front, right or another view (with hidden lines)
messages.合并选中的面域或三维实体: Combine the selected regions or 3D solids
messages.从最先创建的面域或三维实体中减去其余选中的对象: Subtract the other selected objects from the region or 3D solid created first
messages.求选中的面域或三维实体的公共部分: Keep the common part of the selected regions or 3D solids
